candidates.explanation: The provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google when createUserDto.provider is not set. Email registration (AuthService.register) doesn't pass a provider, so the new user is stored with provider 'google'. At login, AuthService.validateLogin checks user.provider !== email and returns 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'.

fix.description: Default the provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email instead of google.
